display.purpose: The two per-screen heroes only: Home's clock, Car's battery percentage.

headline.purpose: Big readouts: weather temp, Energy tariff values, chart figures.

body.purpose: Card copy, list rows, toggle labels.

label.purpose: Chip captions, muted units, uppercase tracked text.

shadows.name: card-lift-dark
shadows.purpose: Default soft elevation for every charcoal surface card.

shadows.name: card-lift-light
shadows.purpose: Lighter-weight elevation for the warm panel hero card.

motion.name: tap-feedback
motion.purpose: Immediate press confirmation on any interactive Card (active:scale-0.97) and toggle switches.

motion.name: ambient-state-fade
motion.purpose: LightCard's background/brightness-thumb transitions — a slow, deliberate ambient fade.

components.name: Card (surface)
components.description: Default charcoal bento tile with a soft real shadow; built-in tap vs. 1000ms long-press handling.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #18181c; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 92%); border-radius: 28px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -28px rgb(0 0 0 / 65%); }

components.name: Card (panel)
components.description: The one warm light hero card per screen — near-black text on a warm off-white surface.
components.css: .ds-card-panel { background: #eeece6; color: #1a1a1c; border-radius: 28px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -26px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%); }

components.name: IconBadge
components.description: Circular dark icon holder, 44px default — the system's one recurring chrome motif.
components.css: .ds-icon-badge { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #232328; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 92%); }

components.name: StatChip (pink)
components.description: Pastel glass tile carrying one value + label; the atomic 'one stat, one color' unit.
components.css: .ds-stat-chip { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; border-radius: 20px; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-stat-chip--pink { background: #f4d9ea; color: #b6467e; } .ds-stat-chip__value { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-stat-chip__label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: TileButton (sidebar nav)
components.description: 56-64px square nav tile. Muted icon at rest; active route fills with its assigned pastel chip tone + scale(1.05).
components.css: .ds-tile-button { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; margin: 8px; border-radius: 20px; color: #97959d; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-tile-button:hover { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 92%); } .ds-tile-button--active { background: #f4d9ea; color: #b6467e; transform: scale(1.05); }

components.name: ToggleRow (Car screen)
components.description: Tap-to-toggle list row: icon badge, label, iOS-style pill switch. Backs every Tesla switch-domain control.
components.css: .ds-toggle-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; background: none; border: none; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 92%); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle-row__label { flex: 1; font-weight: 500; } .ds-toggle-row__switch { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 44px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 15%); transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-toggle-row__switch--on { background: #a97a2b; } .ds-toggle-row__thumb { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-toggle-row__switch--on .ds-toggle-row__thumb { transform: translateX(20px); }

components.name: LightCard (signature, carried forward)
components.description: A full card that is also a light toggle. Background is the bulb's live RGB color (or chip-amber fallback), transitioning over 1000ms. Unchanged in behavior from the prior visual world.
components.css: .ds-light-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; min-height: 125px; width: 100%; padding: 24px; border: none; border-radius: 28px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; text-align: left; transition: background-color 1000ms ease; box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -28px rgb(0 0 0 / 65%); } .ds-light-card--on { background: #f6e8cf; color: #1a1a1c; } .ds-light-card__label { font-weight: 700; } .ds-light-card__track { position: relative; height: 12px; width: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 15%); } .ds-light-card__thumb { position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1a1a1c; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transition: left 1000ms ease; }

narrative.overview:
Redesigned 2026-08-31, replacing the prior flat 'Night Console' system on the user's own pinned brief (a reference image: 'match feel, not content') plus new scope — a Tesla Model 3 control screen and expanded room sensors. The old look is kept only as evidence of what worked functionally; its visual language — pure black, zero elevation, tonal-only depth — is retired, not extended.

The new world tiles the dashboard as a bento grid: charcoal (#18181c) cards of varying sizes on a near-black canvas, each carrying a soft, real drop shadow rather than the old system's flat tonal steps. Exactly one warm, light contrast panel (#eeece6, near-black text) anchors each screen as its 'hero'. Circular dark icon badges and soft pastel glass chips carry every discrete value. No stock or generated photography is used anywhere — this is real household data, not a showroom.
keyCharacteristics: One hero light panel per screen; every other surface is charcoal.
Depth comes from a real, soft shadow now, not tonal layering alone.
Every discrete stat lives in a pastel glass chip, one color, one meaning.
Circular icon badges are the one recurring chrome motif, everywhere.
Zero literal reuse of the reference's content — only its material language.

rules.name: The One Hero Rule
rules.body: Exactly one panel (light) card per screen. A second light panel on the same view means the hierarchy hasn't been decided yet.

rules.name: The Chip, Not the Card Rule
rules.body: A discrete stat gets a pastel chip. A card's own background is never the value's color-carrier.

rules.name: The No-Alarm-Red Rule
rules.body: Red stays reserved for genuine errors. Peak tariff cost is amber, not red.

rules.name: The Bold-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for weight (500→700) before reaching for size to add emphasis inside a card.

rules.name: The Bento Tiling Rule
rules.body: Every screen is a grid of rounded-bento tiles of deliberately varied size and shape — never a uniform grid of equal cards.

rules.name: The Hero-Plus-Satellites Rule
rules.body: Structure each screen as one large hero panel plus a cluster of smaller charcoal satellites around it.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are wide, soft, and low-contrast — never a hard offset, never a glow/neon edge.

dos: Do give every screen exactly one panel hero and keep everything else surface.
Do put a discrete stat in a pastel StatChip, never as a card's own background color.
Do use rounded-bento (28px) for cards and rounded-tile (20px) for nested elements.
Do carry the tariff domain colors forward unchanged wherever the actual price band is shown.
Do give every card a soft, wide shadow.
donts: Don't revert to flat, shadowless cards or the old pure-black/slate tonal-step system.
Don't use more than one panel (light) card per screen.
Don't use a saturated Tailwind-default color anywhere a pastel chip tone or a domain color already covers the need.
Don't use red for anything but a genuine error; peak tariff cost is amber.
Don't add stock or AI-generated photography.
